technique_name: Describe the significance of the Internet of Things.
description: The Internet of Things (IoT) is the network of physical devices, vehicles, home appliances, and other items embedded with electronics, software, sensors, and network connectivity which enable these objects to connect and exchange data. The Internet of Things has become an important part of today’s digital infrastructure, playing an integral role in improving many aspects of the human experience such as healthcare, transportation, and communication.
